To complete my new office setup, I needed a monitor stand for my planned 5x1 portrait-orientation setup. After looking at a bunch of commercial stands I decided to build my own.

Materials: Dressed pine and some 9mm MDF sheet for the spacers between the risers and the VESA mounting holes.

Total build time: About 2 days, not including time for the paint to dry.

Tools used: Miter saw, cordless drill, set square.

For bonus points, here are some notes I took along the way. :)

evasion moves:

*By "all melee", I mean Melee Basic Attacks and Strike Supers

*By "all Ki Blasts", I mean Ki Basic Attacks and Ki Blast Supers.

poses stack, but in a specific way. the latest pose will extend/refresh all previously stacked poses duration. it will also overwrite any previous stat changes to a specific stat. so if you do Pose K, you'll get a debuff making you recieve 20% more damage (also, it lasts shortly), but if you afterwards do pose E, final pose, Justice pose or hero's pose or land a recoome kick, (fighting sun, prepare to be punished? transformations? nah), it will refresh the duration and defence buff, cause those have +20% defence buffs. (also basic attack buffs are always chained together with defence buffs for some reason)

super armor and guarding poses, invincibility, perks and z-souls tend to conflict alot though. otherwise "special effect" poses stack, with exception of a few gamebreaking combinations.

special effects:

Fighting Pose A: Autoguard (still drains stamina)

Fighting Pose C: can't be poisoned or get slowdown debuffs (doesn't work as no-stagger)

Fighting Pose F: "stamina super armor". can not recover stamina normally, can be guard broken, no stagger or damage recieved until all stamina is depleted. drain stamina instead of life until it's broken, and no auto stamina recovery, not even with stamina recovery buffs (not after the patch) Fighting Pose J: doubles stamina recovery!

Fighting Pose K: "no stagger super armor", wont flinch or get pushed or thrown, +20% damage taken

.

Kaioken x3: +15% to all attacks.

.

Super Vegeta 2: +5% to all Ki Blasts, +2% to all Melee +10% Ki Damage Reduction, inifnite ki usage while active

.

there are also unoptainable transformations, like "villanous mode" or "villanous mode ssj2" or the ssj in pq's that are infinite. or ssj3, or "potential unleashed" (not to be confused with "unlock potential".)
